note: Ground punch to the BODY from half guard, keyed against the pose it is thrown from for the same reason the head punch is: the chest is flat here, its forward pointing down at the mat and its up along the mat ahead of him, so a clip keyed off the mount sends the hand out over the man's head. The right hand is already at his waist with a leg trapped; it lifts clear, turns over and digs back into the ribs.

keys.note: a short lift clear of him, not a wind-up
